name: tkhq-ff
description: Convenience scripts for running the backend and frontend together. backend/ and frontend/ stay independent npm projects with their own lockfiles — this is deliberately not an npm workspace.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
